name: wisply
description: Use your Wisply meeting notes, action items and live transcript in your editor's AI chat, from the Wisply app on this Mac.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In Restricted Mode, Wisply reads its settings only from your user settings.

commands.title: Store Token in the Mac Keychain…

wisply.port.markdownDescription: The port of Wisply's MCP server on this Mac, as shown in Wisply > Settings > Integrations > MCP Server. Wisply reads this setting only from your user settings on this computer: not from a workspace, a dev container or a remote machine, and Settings Sync doesn't copy it.

wisply.mcp.allowClaudeSetup.markdownDescription: Offer Wisply's `setup_claude` tool to AI chat when a full-access token is set with **Wisply: Set Token**. The tool can replace the Anthropic API key saved in Wisply, so it is off by default. Wisply reads this setting only from your user settings on this computer: not from a workspace, a dev container or a remote machine, and Settings Sync doesn't copy it to your other computers.

wisply.statusBar.enabled.markdownDescription: Show Wisply's recording state in the status bar. While the window is focused, the extension asks Wisply for it every 10 seconds during a recording and every 30 seconds otherwise. Wisply reads this setting only from your user settings.

wisply.quote.words.markdownDescription: How many of the last words of the recording in progress **Wisply: Insert Transcript Quote** inserts (10 to 400). Wisply reads this setting only from your user settings.

enumDescriptions: A Markdown block quote that ends with a line naming Wisply, the memo title and the date.
One line: the quote in double quotes, then Wisply, the memo title and the date in parentheses.
wisply.quote.format.markdownDescription: How **Wisply: Insert Transcript Quote** formats a quote. Wisply reads this setting only from your user settings.
